name: screw-top-jar
why: The seeded printed-thread part: a jar with an M40 x 3 neck and its cap, two bodies, 0.25 mm clearance on each. Closed forms, derived in the part's header from the slab form of a thread (a horizontal slice of a screw-symmetric solid has one area at every height): jar 88357.293 + 8369.020 - 68138.003 - 8625.243 = 19963.068 mm3, cap 21714.688 - 11758.317 = 9956.371 mm3; the exact solids read 19963.054 and 9956.381 through probe_step_export (-7e-7, +1e-6), and the recorded volumes are the meshes'. The cap's cutter is turned 120 degrees to bring it in phase with the neck, whose frames sit 2/3 of a pitch apart; in phase, the flank gap is 0.25 (2/sqrt3) / sqrt(4/3 + (P/2 pi r)^2) = 0.2499 mm at the cap's crest, read as clear at 0.250. Out of phase the same pair reads interfering, which is what between_bodies is for.
